$description: P31 device-tier contract. Maps CAPABILITY (pointer/hover/window size class) to delivery tier — never device brand. Window size classes follow Material 3: Compact <600dp, Medium 600-840dp, Expanded >=840dp. Pointer and hover are independent capability axes: they are reported as flags at runtime and never override the window size class (runbook §2.5, §6 B-2).

embedded.rationale: Node Zero (ESP32-S3) is an explicit hardware context, not a browser viewport: no window size class, no pointer/hover media queries. Served UI is HTML-first minimal-html into the ~4MB SPIFFS assets partition; LVGL 8.4 panel consumes lvgl-c constants. touchTargetMin 44 applies to the AXS15231B touch panel (iOS HIG / WCAG 2.5.5 floor). maxGzipBytes 102400 is the discipline budget keeping room for fonts/emojis per the partitions.csv comment (runbook §2.8, §6 B-1). Embedded tier is a subset of the same tokens, never a fork (Law 5, runbook §2.6).

mobile.rationale: M3 Compact window size class (<600dp). Mobile web/PWA is the default tier — 99% of users (runbook §0, Law 6). Coarse pointer + hover:none are the NOMINAL capabilities of this tier, not a definition of it: a 1200px coarse touch device is desktop tier with flags.coarse true, because pointer/hover are independent of width (runbook §2.5 — touch is capability, not screen size). 44px touch floor per iOS HIG / WCAG 2.5.5. safeAreaInsets true: bottom-nav chrome must consume env(safe-area-inset-*).

tablet.rationale: M3 Medium window size class (600-840dp). pointer/hover 'mixed' reflects the real devices in this band — foldables, detachables, and the operator's Acer Spin 713 2-in-1 in tablet posture. The window size class is DYNAMIC, not device-locked: ChromeOS resizable windows make the same hardware cross classes on resize (runbook §2.5, Law 8). 44px floor retained because coarse capability may be present.

desktop.rationale: M3 Expanded window size class (>=840dp). Fine pointer + hover are nominal; the 34px compact floor is permitted ONLY under (pointer: fine) (runbook §2.5, §6 C-2). When a desktop-width device reports pointer:coarse (touchscreen Chromebook, the dev box itself), the tier stays desktop — the resolver surfaces flags.coarse true and consumers must apply the 44px floor per capability, never silently collapse it (runbook §6 B-2 negative control).
